## v7.8.60 — 2026-10-27 · cache manager, Turn off / Remove APO, no stale copies of moved pages
- **Change:** (A) **the old address of a page that moved or left "published" is purged.** `save_post` purged `get_permalink()` AFTER the
  change, when WordPress had already renamed a trashed slug (`about-us__trashed`) or switched a draft to `?page_id=N`; the old address
  kept its stored copy and answered **200** (10 years on Maximum): a deleted page stayed indexed in Google, unpublished content stayed
  public, a renamed slug kept a duplicate instead of WordPress's 301. Now `post_updated` purges `get_permalink($post_before)` (+ host
  cache for it) and `before_delete_post` purges a published post deleted outright. (Private was not affected: the editor keeps the same
  address.) Also: a purge no longer deletes the page cache's `.disabled` flag, so **Disable Page Cache now sticks** (any purge - a menu
  or theme save - silently re-enabled it). (B) **Cache Manager** (emitted with the page cache / drop-in, survives uninstall):
  Accelerator-style scope dropdown (All cached pages / Front page / Specific URLs / every public post type) + URL box; **Revalidate**
  (zero-gap: one or two pages are rebuilt in place for phone + desktop; a larger scope moves the copies into the existing
  stale-while-revalidate window, so visitors keep the current copy and nothing is deleted), **Delete**, **Clear host / CDN cache**;
  status (copies, disk size, oldest/newest). Lives under the APO menu ("Cache Manager", plus a Dashboard item) and on the Cache tab
  while the plugin is installed, in Settings -> Performance after it is removed. **Admin bar "Cache Settings" now also on the page
  itself** (admins only): Revalidate this page, Clear this page, Clear All Cache, Cache Manager, Enable/Disable Page Cache (the label
  said "Disable" in both states). (C) **Turn off APO / Turn on APO** (replaces "Pause", which only skipped the passes): the panel now
  registers first and the mu-plugin returns before anything else - no pass, no page cache, no beacon, as if the file were absent;
  the drop-in's `.disabled` flag is written and APO + host caches are cleared; Turn on restores the flag as it was. A site paused
  today is now fully off. (D) **Remove APO completely** (Settings -> Performance, typed REMOVE): backs up and deletes
  `apo-applied.php`, APO's own `advanced-cache.php` (never a foreign one; `WP_CACHE` left alone), the page cache, logs, tripwires and
  APO's options, clears host caches; **keeps the public optimised files in uploads/apo-*** so old copies of the pages never 404.
  (E) **Full Reset keeps the public optimised files** unless the new box is ticked.
- **Presets:** C/D in all 7 (the panel is un-gated); A/B where the page cache or drop-in is emitted (Maximum, Auto, or ticked in
  Configure). no-layout-risk: admin code + purges; with APO on, every preset's emitted code = v7.8.59 apart from these blocks.
- **Search Console (researched):** APO never had the Breeze problem - a page keeps one cache name (`md5(path|device)`) and every
  CSS/JS/image file a page uses is named by its content or version and is never deleted by a cache clear. Only Full Reset deleted
  them (E). The real APO gap was (A).
- **Worst case:** the off option read wrongly = APO off on a site (speed lost, nothing broken) - guarded by a unique option, a red
  admin notice while off, and the kill switch; an accidental Remove = the site runs original (typed confirmation, backup kept).
- **Kill switches:** `APO_NO_OLD_URL_PURGE`, `APO_NO_CACHE_MANAGER`, `APO_NO_OFF_SWITCH`, `APO_NO_CLIENT_PANEL`.
- **Measured:** `test_v7860` 106/106: all 7 presets as applied - panel + off switch, Cache Manager exactly with the page cache, and
  everything else = v7.8.59 line for line. The EMITTED code in a stubbed WordPress: trash / draft / slug / parent / delete each remove
  the old address's copies (v7.8.59 control kept them); the flag survives a purge (v7.8.59 deleted it); off registers only the panel;
  Turn off/on, Remove (foreign drop-in and uploads/apo-* kept, no REMOVE = nothing removed), Revalidate all (every copy in the stale
  window, none deleted), one page (rendered in place; loopback blocked -> stale, not deleted), Delete scope, admin bar, panel pages.
